# Input

Labelled text field with soft rounding and a blue focus ring.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Input` · Forms


## Notes

Labelled text field with blue focus ring, matches the demo-request forms.

## Props (InputProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Field label. |
| `hint` | `React.ReactNode` | Helper text under the field. |
| `error` | `React.ReactNode` | Error message (overrides hint, turns the field red). |
| `warning` | `React.ReactNode` | Warning message (amber border): valid but worth a second look, e.g. a non-.edu email. |
| `success` | `React.ReactNode` | Success message (green border). |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Validating / looking up: spinner at inline-end, aria-busy. @default false |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disable the field. @default false |
| `iconStart` | `React.ReactNode` | Icon inside the field at inline-start (follows reading direction). |
| `iconEnd` | `React.ReactNode` | Icon inside the field at inline-end. |
| `iconLeft` | `React.ReactNode` | Alias of iconStart. |
| `iconRight` | `React.ReactNode` | Alias of iconEnd. |
| `required` | `boolean` | Show a required asterisk. @default false |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | Render a multi-line textarea. @default false |

_Also accepts: React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement & HTMLTextAreaElement>._
